m.id AS messageId, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.sender_user_id AS senderUserId, up.username AS senderUsername, up.name AS senderName, up.avatar AS senderAvatar, m.message_type AS messageType, CASE WHEN m.status = 0 AND m.message_type IN ('PROJECT_CREATION_APPLICATION', 'PROJECT_CREATE_RESULT') THEN CAST(m.content AS CHAR) WHEN m.status = 0 AND m.message_type = 'TEXT' THEN m.content_text WHEN m.status = 0 AND m.message_type IN ('ANNOUNCEMENT', 'SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION') THEN CAST(m.content AS CHAR) ELSE NULL END AS content, CASE WHEN m.status = 0 THEN CAST(m.content AS CHAR) ELSE NULL END AS rawContent, m.client_message_id AS clientMessageId, m.status AS status, m.recall_by_user_id AS recallByUserId, m.recall_time AS recallTime, m.recall_reason AS recallReason,
CASE WHEN c.type = 'DIRECT' AND m.sender_user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN MAX( CASE WHEN rcm.user_id <> #{currentUserId} AND rcm.status = 0 AND rcm.last_read_message_id >= m.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) ELSE 0 END AS readByPeer, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN c.type IN ('TEAM', 'TEAM_NOTIFICATION') AND rcm.status = 0 AND rcm.user_id <> m.sender_user_id AND rcm.last_read_message_id >= m.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS readCount, m.create_time AS createTime

FROM im_message m JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id LEFT JOIN im_user_profile up ON up.user_id = m.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN im_conversation_member rcm ON rcm.conversation_id = m.conversation_id

GROUP BY m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_user_id, up.username, up.name, up.avatar, m.message_type, m.content, m.content_text, m.status, m.client_message_id, m.recall_by_user_id, m.recall_time, m.recall_reason, c.type, m.create_time

recent.messageId, recent.conversationId, recent.senderUserId, recent.senderUsername, recent.senderName, recent.senderAvatar, recent.messageType, recent.content, recent.rawContent, recent.clientMessageId, recent.status, recent.recallByUserId, recent.recallTime, recent.recallReason, recent.readByPeer, recent.readCount, recent.createTime
